events.title: Docker 19.03 released
events.summary: Docker Inc. released Docker Engine 19.03 on July 22, 2019 — bringing rootless mode and integrated BuildKit (opt-in via DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1).
events.about: Docker 19.03 shipped faster multi-stage builds when BuildKit was enabled — `docker build` with BuildKit cut CI times for teams that turned it on. Rootless mode improved security on shared developer machines; BuildKit became the default builder in Docker 23.0.

narrative.whyChosen: Docker 19.03 made BuildKit the default, modernizing container builds.
narrative.whyImportant: It improved build speed and security for everyday Docker users.
narrative.problemSolved: Legacy Docker builds were slow and required root daemon access.
